scope: campaign execution, Run Theater, retained timelines, CSV, per-run and suite reports, run Grafana dashboard

issues.finding: Connection counts were rendered as HTTP rates
issues.correction: Separate connection panels and units in live, replay and reports

issues.finding: Absent external-engine counters became measured zeros
issues.correction: Explicit generator provenance; blank unknown CSV values; no reconstructed historical time-series

issues.finding: Generator errors declared an outage or mitigation without supporting probe observations
issues.correction: Neutral generator-error banner; probe impact presented separately; no edge or origin attribution

issues.finding: Successful response curves inferred outcomes from unfinished attempts
issues.correction: Use the successful counter and the same generator rate window as the tiles

issues.finding: Live probe p95 was lost from the stored timeline
issues.correction: Persist p95 and completed observation counts; expose cumulative semantics and stepped sample plots

issues.finding: App and runner published duplicate Prometheus series on different clocks and label sets
issues.correction: One producer with target and vector labels; absent series omitted

issues.finding: Grafana live failures fell back to a previous settled run
issues.correction: Instant live queries without historical fallback; no smoothing or null spanning

issues.finding: Reports conflated scenario completion, safety stops and resilience outcomes
issues.correction: Independent execution and verdict wording; diagnostic WRS is not a measured DRS score

issues.finding: Mean-rate peaks and source protocol capability were overstated
issues.correction: Explicit maximum-recorded-mean labels; unconfirmed HTTP/2 scope is inconclusive

issues.finding: Cached historical interpretations diverged from regenerated reports
issues.correction: Read-time assessment projection from preserved evidence, without writing historical measurements

issues.finding: Wave/ramp rounding changed a 20-second window to 21 seconds
issues.correction: Phase durations sum exactly to the requested total

issues.finding: k6 missing summary fields and verbose output lost usable execution evidence
issues.correction: Bounded quiet output; validate exported counters; retain diagnostics and process-output ceiling

qualificationLimits: Short probe traces do not establish continuous outage duration
Missing historical p95 cannot be reconstructed
HTTP-only target does not qualify HTTP/2 resilience
No physical DRS certification or capacity inferred
